# openwebui_tool_servers_config (Resource)

Manages the list of external tool server registrations for Open WebUI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwebui_tool_servers_config" "example" {
  connections = [
    {
      url       = "http://tools.internal:8080"
      path      = "/openapi.json"
      auth_type = "bearer"
      key       = var.tool_server_api_key
    },
  ]
}

variable "tool_server_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connections` (Attributes List) List of tool server connection entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connections))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier. Set by Open WebUI.

<a id="nestedatt--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections`

Required:

- `path` (String) Path to the tool server's OpenAPI spec, e.g. `/openapi.json`.
- `url` (String) Base URL of the tool server, e.g. `http://tools.internal:8080`.

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type for the tool server, e.g. `bearer`.
- `config_json` (String) Additional JSON configuration sent to the tool server.
- `headers_json` (String) JSON object of extra HTTP headers to send to the tool server. e.g. `jsonencode({ X-Api-Version = "2" })`.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) API key or bearer token for authenticating with the tool server. Sensitive.
- `type` (String) Tool server type identifier.
